program.name: audren
docs: Audren — Global Multi-Asset Shielded Pool (BN254 Groth16, 4-ary Depth-20 MASP) and Protocol-Agnostic DeFi Execution Program on Solana.

accounts.name: poolState
docs: Global pool configuration (128 B; read-only on all deposits, spends, checkpoints, and DeFi swaps).

accounts.name: laneTreeState
docs: Per-lane 4-ary Depth-18 incremental Poseidon4 frontier (1,824 B).

accounts.name: subtreePage
docs: Append-only 256-leaf note commitment page (8,256 B <= 10 KiB).

accounts.name: subtreeRootPage
docs: Append-only 300 finalized 256-leaf subtree roots page (9,664 B <= 10 KiB).

accounts.name: memoPage
docs: Versioned Structure-of-Arrays 96 x 106 B note memo page (10,240 B == 10 KiB CPI cap).

accounts.name: nullifierPage
docs: Append-only 600 x 16 B nullifier prefix page for zero-leakage wallet sync (9,664 B <= 10 KiB).

accounts.name: rootCheckpoint
docs: Fixed-size cyclic global checkpoint ring slot (704 B, 256 slots max).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Initial pool authority and rent payer.

instructions.name: initLane
docs: Authority-gated sequential append-lane activation (0 -> 4 -> 8 -> 16) with zero circuit changes.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Pool authority and initial page-0 rent payer.

instructions.name: openPage
docs: Idempotent, sequence-bounded, pause-exempt, LaneRentVault-subsidized page opener.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Unified deposit for Native SOL (via DEPOSIT_FLAG_NATIVE_SOL + SyncNative into WSOL vault ATA) and Classic SPL / Token-2022 (net TransferFee + active TransferHook) into canonical vault_auth ATA.

accounts.name: mint
docs: WSOL, Classic SPL, or Token-2022 Mint.

accounts.name: sourceAccount
docs: Depositor signer pubkey (when DEPOSIT_FLAG_NATIVE_SOL) or depositor token account.

accounts.name: vaultAta
docs: Canonical vault_auth Associated Token Account for mint.

accounts.name: tokenProgram
docs: Classic SPL Token or Token-2022 program.

instructions.name: publishCheckpoint
docs: Permissionless, pause-exempt global super_root checkpoint publisher over active_lanes read-only lanes.

instructions.name: transact
docs: Unified 2-in -> 3-out BN254 Groth16 private transfer (shielded cm2 fee) or public withdraw from canonical vault_auth ATA (incl. atomic WSOL unwrap & pause-exempt full exit).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Transaction fee & nullifier rent payer (relayer or user).

accounts.name: nullifier1
docs: Secondary NullifierPDA (or System Program when economy nf1 == 0).

instructions.name: execViaEscrow
docs: Atomic SPL / Token-2022 DeFi CPI behind WatchedEscrowBuf firewall with canonical vault/escrow ATAs, optional EXEC_FLAG_FEE_ON_OUTPUT, and XOR-masked 72 B dynamic output memo.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Transaction fee & nullifier rent payer (never signs router CPI).

accounts.name: nullifier1
docs: Secondary NullifierPDA (or System Program when economy nf1 == 0).

accounts.name: swapEscrow
docs: Isolated swap_escrow shard PDA (sole router CPI signer).

instructions.name: setPaused
docs: Authority-only emergency pause toggle (full withdrawals, PublishCheckpoint, and OpenPage remain permanently open).

instructions.name: updatePool
docs: Update pool governance parameters or execute two-step authority transfer / renounce (renounce requires !paused).

pdas.name: vaultAuthority
docs: Unified WSOL / Classic SPL / Token-2022 custody vault ATA owner PDA.

pdas.name: laneTreeState
docs: Per-lane 4-ary Depth-18 incremental frontier PDA (1,824 B).

pdas.name: laneRentVault
docs: Per-lane self-funding rent sentinel PDA (16 B).

pdas.name: memoPage
docs: 96 x 106 B versioned SoA encrypted note memos PDA (10,240 B).

pdas.name: nullifierPage
docs: 600 x 16 B nullifier prefixes PDA for ordinary-RPC spent sync (9,664 B).

pdas.name: rootCheckpoint
docs: Cyclic 256-slot global super_root checkpoint ring PDA (704 B).

pdas.name: nullifier
docs: Canonical 0-byte global spent-nullifier replay guard PDA.

pdas.name: swapEscrow
docs: Isolated DeFi CPI signer shard PDA (0..16).

pdas.name: unwrapAccount
docs: Ephemeral 1-shot WSOL unwrap token account PDA.
